description: This file contains classes and functions for executing, managing, and reporting on scheduled reports and alerts within the Superset platform. It includes state machine implementations for report states, methods for generating report content (screenshots, PDFs, CSVs), and notification handling logic.

classes.name: BaseReportState
classes.description: Base class implementing common report state behaviors, including updating report status, generating URLs, screenshots, PDFs, CSVs, and notifications.

classes.name: ReportNotTriggeredErrorState
classes.description: Handles the initial 'not triggered' and 'error' states, managing alert triggering and error logging.

classes.name: ReportWorkingState
classes.description: Represents the 'working' state, managing timeout checks and state transitions.

classes.name: ReportSuccessState
classes.description: Represents the 'success' and 'grace' states, handling post-success logic and alert re-triggering.

classes.name: ReportScheduleStateMachine
classes.description: Manages the transition between report states based on current status and triggers.

classes.name: AsyncExecuteReportScheduleCommand
classes.description: Asynchronous command to execute report schedules, including validation, user override, and state machine execution.

methods.name: update_report_schedule_and_log
methods.description: Updates report schedule state and logs the execution result.

methods.name: update_report_schedule
methods.description: Updates the report schedule's last state, evaluation time, and clears last values if needed.

methods.name: update_report_schedule_slack_v2
methods.description: Converts Slack recipients to v2 format with channel IDs.

methods.name: create_log
methods.description: Creates a report execution log entry.

methods.name: _get_url
methods.description: Generates URL for chart or dashboard, considering result format and feature flags.

methods.name: get_dashboard_urls
methods.description: Retrieves URLs for dashboard tabs or the main dashboard.

methods.name: _get_tab_url
methods.description: Generates URL for a specific dashboard tab.

methods.name: _get_tabs_urls
methods.description: Generates URLs for multiple dashboard tabs.

methods.name: _get_screenshots
methods.description: Captures screenshots of charts or dashboards, handling timeouts and errors.

methods.name: _get_pdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF from screenshots.

methods.name: _get_csv_data
methods.description: Generates CSV data from chart URL.

methods.name: _get_embedded_data
methods.description: Returns chart data as a pandas DataFrame for embedding.

methods.name: _update_query_context
methods.description: Ensures chart query context is saved, or triggers a screenshot to generate it.

methods.name: _get_log_data
methods.description: Prepares header data for logs and notifications.

methods.name: _get_notification_content
methods.description: Builds notification content including screenshots, PDFs, CSVs, or embedded data.

methods.name: _send
methods.description: Sends notifications to recipients, handling errors and retries.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Creates notification content and dispatches to all recipients.

methods.name: send_error
methods.description: Sends an error notification to owners.

methods.name: is_in_grace_period
methods.description: Checks if the report is within its alert grace period.

methods.name: is_in_error_grace_period
methods.description: Checks if the report error notification is within its grace period.

methods.name: is_on_working_timeout
methods.description: Checks if the report is in a working timeout.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Transitions to the next report state based on current conditions.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the report state machine logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates and loads the report schedule model.
